title: Potato and Onion Burekas
subtitle: in rolled pilas pastry
description: Small rolls of thin pilas pastry filled with mashed potato and soft onion, left open at the ends so the filling peeks out while baking.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line 3 trays with baking paper. Boil, peel and mash the potatoes.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add the olive oil and finely chopped onion and fry for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft. Cool well.
Transfer the onion to a bowl with its oil. Add the mashed potato, season with salt and pepper, mix, then taste and adjust.

Spread the pastry on the work surface with the plastic side down. Cut across into 15 strips 6 cm wide, then cut each strip into 3 rectangles to make 45 rectangles of 6 x 8 cm. Place a teaspoon of filling along the narrow edge of each rectangle and roll into a small log (there is no need to seal the ends; the filling peeks out a little while baking).
Place the burekas on the trays seam side down. Beat the egg with the water, brush over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes until golden. Serve hot with hard-boiled eggs, olives and cucumbers. Store airtight in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat at 170°C for a few minutes.
